title: Drone System Validation Engineer Intern
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Drone System Validation Engineer Intern, you will own one well-defined validation topic for six months within our Validation team in Paris or Lausanne. Your topic is agreed during the interview process and fitted to your profile. You will work hands-on with our autonomous drone systems across simulation, lab, bench and flight testing. The team uses your work directly as it scales its test activities, and strong performers have a natural path to a full-time Validation Engineer role. Responsibilities Scope your validation topic and agree on a plan and deliverables with the team in your first month. Prepare and run flight and bench test campaigns, including setup, execution and issue reporting. Analyze flight logs and telemetry to explain system behavior and find the root cause of anomalies. Write and improve test procedures so campaigns stay consistent across sites and teams. Share findings with Flight Operations, Automated Testing, GNC and embedded software teams. Stay in constant touch with the validation team and iterate on their feedback, then document, hand over and present your results at the end. Candidate Requirements Final-year engineering or MSc student in aerospace, robotics, mechatronics, electronics, embedded systems or a related field. Able to complete a six-month end-of-studies internship under an agreement with your school. Hands-on project experience (student drone, rocket or robotics team, lab project, internship), ideally testing or debugging physical systems. Rigorous test mindset: you check results, question surprises and trace issues to their root cause. Autonomous and able to turn a loosely defined brief into a concrete result. Collaborative team player who is comfortable with outdoor field days in all weather. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
